name: Berm - MTB tracker
summary: Mountain bike tracker for iPhone that records GPS rides and reports descents, air time and jump metrics.
description: An App Store listing for a mountain bike tracker by developer Pedro Marques. The app records rides with start, pause and stop controls, live time, distance and speed, and GPS routes, then shows post-ride insights like distance, duration, descents, air time, top speed, elevation and jump metrics. Free with in-app purchases; 3 ratings.
